purpose: Durable planning memory for independent ADWF audits. This registry is historical context, not live provider truth.

before_new_audit: Read this registry and the latest referenced audit report before forming recommendations.
Re-read current main/provider/runtime state; prior audit findings are not current-state evidence.
Compare the new factual state with prior accepted decisions and report the delta.
Do not re-propose deferred/rejected capabilities without new consumer evidence or a changed constraint.
Do not claim an accepted recommendation is implemented until repository/provider/runtime evidence proves it.
When superseding a prior decision, record the new audit/decision and the reason for supersession.
rules.authority: Owner-accepted audit decisions are planning constraints until explicitly superseded; live facts always require fresh evidence.
rules.implementation_truth: AUDIT_ACCEPTED does not imply IMPLEMENTED or LIVE_VERIFIED.

audits.owner_decision: Внедрить результаты аудита и сохранить историю для последующих AI-аудитов.
audits.headline: Сильное governance/control-plane ядро уже существует; следующий critical path — Engineering Truth, Consumer Lifecycle, heterogeneous conformance и Human-by-Exception proof, а не расширение Core ради расширения.
accepted_release_train: v2.0.0 Engineering OS Foundation Stable / FOUNDATION_READY
accepted_decisions: ADWF 2.x is an evolution/stabilization of the existing architecture, not a rewrite.
Prefer extending existing subsystems; new subsystem only when existing contracts cannot represent the capability safely.
Do not create hundreds of long-horizon Issues now; use rolling-wave planning and detail the current release only.
First implementation priority is Capability Truth Model v2, then Roadmap/Outcome truth, AIWorkPackage/AIWorkResult and durable Decision/Traceability contracts.
Consumer product must outlive the framework: bootstrap/adopt/upgrade/rollback/detach/recover are Foundation requirements.
Reference conformance must cover standard web/software, Apps Script/data-centric and edge/automation classes.
FOUNDATION_READY must be a machine-verifiable gate rather than a documentation claim.
After FOUNDATION_READY, ADWF development should become primarily consumer-driven by Family Digital Platform, PrihRashOnline, Wiren Board and other real products.
Do not prematurely introduce Kubernetes, Kafka, service mesh, Redis, vector DB, mandatory paid AI APIs or a custom CI backend without real consumer evidence.

audits.owner_decision: Принять Mega Audit как Roadmap input: автономность и непрерывность ADWF — высший текущий приоритет; consumer-работы отложить, но не удалять; process tax измерять и снижать; не превращать ADWF в coding-agent product; сохранять FREE_ONLY, fail-closed и один writer.
audits.headline: Сначала восстановить Engineering Truth и безопасность evidence/authority, доказать устойчивый автономный lifecycle и снизить process tax; fleet, multi-writer, skill factory и большой UI остаются за maturity gates.
accepted_decisions: Autonomy and continuity of ADWF development are the highest current priority.
Consumer implementation is deferred; existing Consumer and other Roadmap work is preserved rather than deleted.
ADWF remains a vendor-neutral governance/evidence/recovery control plane, not another Cursor/Codex/Claude Code analogue.
ADWF process tax is an explicit product objective and must be measured per actually completed capability.
New architecture layers are gated by demonstrated autonomy/continuity value and lower process tax.
UI is deferred except for a thin owner decision/status surface after underlying state becomes trustworthy.
truth_and_safety_priority: Raw owner-intent privacy at public provider sinks
Semantic Trusted Computing Base risk classification
